g.text: no dated tie in the period

3,957 drawable ties dated to this period, among 884 firms across 95 places; the grey firms have no dated tie here. 36.9% of those ties touch Paris — 60.2% if only firms with a street address are counted. Coverage: 36.1% of the 2,656 firms active in the
period can be placed at all. Same coordinates as figures 53 to 56.
